scope: Pure RL on constructively validated original-scale MCA in-vitro low-flow surface-contact simulation
authorization: User instructed: correct physical feasibility first, then train; prior visualization request retained
transition_unit: one environment control step, not individual robot samples
task: Original-scale MCA, random distinct-branch starts, low-pressure in-vitro perfusion, surface-gap contact, all four masses zero
task_limit: Controlled in-vitro simulation feasibility validated; 0.01 mL/min healthy reference flow, 180 s, 1 mm/s ideal actuation; not physiological or hardware validation
reporting: Independent deterministic policy evaluations; diagnostic oracle success never reported as RL success
initialization_sampling: Each episode: shuffled navigable branches without replacement; length-weighted edge, radial offset <=65% of clearance; reject overlaps and invalid lumen projections. No clot-target bias.
entropy_estimator: Reparameterized current-policy tanh entropy; replaces incorrect cross-entropy on rollout actions
comparability: Separate experiment and new mca_surface_36_v2 schema; fresh weights; no oracle warm start or imitation data
